measures.name: Sales Amount (12M average)
measures.formatted_expression:
VAR v_selDate =
MAX ( 'Calendar'[Date] )
VAR v_period =
DATESINPERIOD ( 'Calendar'[Date],
    v_selDate,
    -12,
    MONTH )
VAR v_result =
CALCULATE(
     AVERAGEX ( VALUES ( 'Calendar'[Date] ),
    [Sales Amount] ),
    v_period )
VAR v_firstDate =
MINX ( v_period,
    'Calendar'[Date] )
VAR v_lastDateSales =
MAX ( Sales[Order Date] )
RETURN
IF(
     v_firstDate <= v_lastDateSales,
    v_result )
